BEGIN EXTERNAL DEMONSTRATION demo-02-shipping/legacy.cbl
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. SHIPPING-QUOTE.
       DATA DIVISION.
       LINKAGE SECTION.
       01 PACKAGE-WEIGHT PIC 9(3)V99.
       01 DESTINATION-ZONE PIC X.
       01 QUOTE-AMOUNT PIC 9(5)V99.
       01 QUOTE-STATUS PIC X.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION USING PACKAGE-WEIGHT DESTINATION-ZONE QUOTE-AMOUNT QUOTE-STATUS.
           MOVE 'Y' TO QUOTE-STATUS
           EVALUATE DESTINATION-ZONE
             WHEN 'A' COMPUTE QUOTE-AMOUNT = PACKAGE-WEIGHT * 1.50
             WHEN 'B' COMPUTE QUOTE-AMOUNT = PACKAGE-WEIGHT * 2.25
             WHEN OTHER MOVE ZERO TO QUOTE-AMOUNT MOVE 'N' TO QUOTE-STATUS
           END-EVALUATE
           GOBACK.

END EXTERNAL DEMONSTRATION demo-02-shipping/legacy.cbl

      responses:

BEGIN EXTERNAL DEMONSTRATION demo-02-shipping/mapping.md
# Mapeamento observável

- Peso/zona → requisição; amount → corpo da resposta de sucesso; status Y/N → escolha de HTTP 200/422. O corpo da falha não expõe amount=0 nem o flag N: perda de informação deliberada deste exemplo, não preservação literal de todos os campos.
- Zonas diferentes de A/B permanecem representáveis no request para preservar o ramo `WHEN OTHER` observado.
- Ambiguidade: COBOL não define status HTTP; 422 é mapeamento de transporte explicitamente escolhido, não uma alegação sobre o legado.
- Proveniência: sintético, não derivado de casos avaliados, caso institucional ou E3.

END EXTERNAL DEMONSTRATION demo-02-shipping/mapping.md

           PERFORM 0300-TRANTYPE-OPEN.

                   IF WS-CURR-CARD-NUM NOT= TRAN-CARD-NUM                       
                     IF WS-FIRST-TIME = 'N'                                     
                       PERFORM 1120-WRITE-ACCOUNT-TOTALS                        
                     END-IF                                                     
                     MOVE TRAN-CARD-NUM TO WS-CURR-CARD-NUM                     
                     MOVE TRAN-CARD-NUM TO FD-XREF-CARD-NUM                     
                     PERFORM 1500-A-LOOKUP-XREF

                   PERFORM 1500-B-LOOKUP-TRANTYPE                               
                   MOVE TRAN-TYPE-CD OF TRAN-RECORD

                   MOVE TRAN-CAT-CD OF TRAN-RECORD                              
                     TO FD-TRAN-CAT-CD OF FD-TRAN-CAT-KEY                       
                   PERFORM 1500-C-LOOKUP-TRANCATG                               
                   PERFORM 1100-WRITE-TRANSACTION-REPORT                        
                ELSE

                                 WS-ACCOUNT-TOTAL

                END-IF                                                          
             END-IF

           PERFORM 9200-CARDXREF-CLOSE.                                         
           PERFORM 9300-TRANTYPE-CLOSE.                                         
           PERFORM 9400-TRANCATG-CLOSE.                                         
           PERFORM 9500-DATEPARM-CLOSE.

           GOBACK.                                                              
                                                                                
      * Read the date parameter file.

           PERFORM 1111-WRITE-REPORT-REC                                        
           ADD 1 TO WS-LINE-COUNTER                                             
                                                                                
           MOVE WS-BLANK-LINE TO FD-REPTFILE-REC                                
           PERFORM 1111-WRITE-REPORT-REC                                        
           ADD 1 TO WS-LINE-COUNTER

           PERFORM 1111-WRITE-REPORT-REC                                        
           ADD 1 TO WS-LINE-COUNTER

              MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT

           ELSE                                                                 
              DISPLAY 'ERROR WRITING REPTFILE'                                  
              MOVE TRANREPT-STATUS TO IO-STATUS                                 
              PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS                                    
              PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM

              CONTINUE

              PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS

      *---------------------------------------------------------------*

           CLOSE XREF-FILE
